+                               const size_t numNodes,
+                               const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                               const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int diagonal[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int target[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const size_t tileColumn = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * TILE_SIZE;
+    if (tileColumn == pivotGlobalRow) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t diagonalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+
+            diagonal[y][x] = (globalY < numNodes && diagonalX < numNodes)
+                ? dist[(pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + diagonalX]
+                : INF;
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            target[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = diagonal[y][k] + target[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
                 }
+                target[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Close the local tiles in the pivot tile column using the broadcast diagonal tile.
+__global__ void phase2ColumnKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                                  unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                                  const unsigned int* __restrict__ pivotRow,
+                                  const size_t numNodes,
+                                  const size_t localRowBegin,
+                                  const size_t localRows,
+                                  const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int diagonal[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int target[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const size_t localTileRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * TILE_SIZE;
+    const size_t globalTileRow = localRowBegin + localTileRow;
+    if (globalTileRow == pivotGlobalRow) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+
+            diagonal[y][x] = (pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y) < numNodes && globalX < numNodes)
+                ? pivotRow[static_cast<size_t>(y) * numNodes + globalX]
+                : INF;
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            target[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = target[y][k] + diagonal[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+                target[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Update all remaining local tiles. The pivot row is replicated, while each rank keeps
+// its pivot-column tiles local, so this phase requires no communication.
+__global__ void phase3Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ pivotRow,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t localRowBegin,
+                            const size_t localRows,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnTile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowTile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const size_t tileColumn = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * TILE_SIZE;
+    const size_t localTileRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * TILE_SIZE;
+    const size_t globalTileRow = localRowBegin + localTileRow;
+    if (tileColumn == pivotGlobalRow || globalTileRow == pivotGlobalRow) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t pivotX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+
+            columnTile[y][x] = (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && pivotX < numNodes)
+                ? dist[localY * numNodes + pivotX]
+                : INF;
+            rowTile[y][x] = (pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y) < numNodes && globalX < numNodes)
+                ? pivotRow[static_cast<size_t>(y) * numNodes + globalX]
+                : INF;
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = columnTile[y][k] + rowTile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
             }
         }
     }
 }

+    checkMpi(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD), "pre-compute MPI_Barrier", rank);
+    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
+
+    const dim3 threads(THREAD_TILE, THREAD_TILE);
+    const unsigned int matrixTileCount = static_cast<unsigned int>(tileCount);
+    const unsigned int localTileCount = static_cast<unsigned int>(rankTileEnd - rankTileBegin);
+
+    for (size_t pivotTile = 0; pivotTile < tileCount; ++pivotTile) {
+        const size_t pivotGlobalRow = pivotTile * TILE_SIZE;
+        const size_t pivotRows = std::min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE_SIZE), numNodes - pivotGlobalRow);
+        const int pivotOwner = static_cast<int>(
+            ((pivotTile + 1) * static_cast<size_t>(worldSize) - 1) / tileCount);
+
+        if (rank == pivotOwner) {
+            const size_t pivotLocalRow = pivotGlobalRow - localRowBegin;
+            phase1Kernel<<<1, threads, 0, stream>>>(deviceDistance, devicePath, numNodes,
+                                                    pivotLocalRow, pivotGlobalRow);
+            checkCuda(cudaPeekAtLastError(), "phase1Kernel launch", rank);
+
+            phase2RowKernel<<<matrixTileCount, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+                deviceDistance, devicePath, numNodes, pivotLocalRow, pivotGlobalRow);
+            checkCuda(cudaPeekAtLastError(), "phase2RowKernel launch", rank);
+
+            checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(pivotHost,
+                                      deviceDistance + pivotLocalRow * numNodes,
+                                      pivotRows * numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int),
+                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
+                      "pivot row device-to-host copy", rank);
+            checkCuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), "pivot row production", rank);
+        }
+
+        const size_t pivotElements = pivotRows * numNodes;
+        if (pivotElements > static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+            abortMpi("pivot row is too large for MPI_Bcast", rank);
+        }
+        checkMpi(MPI_Bcast(pivotHost, static_cast<int>(pivotElements), MPI_UNSIGNED,
+                           pivotOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+                 "pivot-row MPI_Bcast", rank);
+
+        checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(devicePivotRow, pivotHost,
+                                  pivotElements * sizeof(unsigned int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream),
+                  "pivot row host-to-device copy", rank);
+
+        if (localTileCount != 0) {
+            phase2ColumnKernel<<<localTileCount, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+                deviceDistance, devicePath, devicePivotRow, numNodes,
+                localRowBegin, localRows, pivotGlobalRow);
+            checkCuda(cudaPeekAtLastError(), "phase2ColumnKernel launch", rank);
+
+            const dim3 phase3Grid(matrixTileCount, localTileCount);
+            phase3Kernel<<<phase3Grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(
+                deviceDistance, devicePath, devicePivotRow, numNodes,
+                localRowBegin, localRows, pivotGlobalRow);
+            checkCuda(cudaPeekAtLastError(), "phase3Kernel launch", rank);
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (localElements != 0) {
+        checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(localHostDistance, deviceDistance,
+                                  localElements * sizeof(unsigned int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
+                  "result device-to-host copy", rank);
+    }
+    checkCuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), "final CUDA synchronization", rank);
+
+    checkMpi(MPI_Gatherv(localHostDistance, static_cast<int>(localElements), MPI_UNSIGNED,
+                         rank == 0 ? distanceMatrix.data() : nullptr,
+                         counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_UNSIGNED,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+             "MPI_Gatherv", rank);
+
+    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
+    double elapsed = 0.0;
+    checkMpi(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
+                        0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+             "timing MPI_Reduce", rank);
+
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        const long durationMs = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);
+        std::printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n", durationMs);
+        const double operations = static_cast<double>(numNodes) * numNodes * numNodes;
+        const double gops = elapsed > 0.0 ? operations / elapsed / 1.0e9 : 0.0;
+        std::printf("Performance: %.3f GOPS\n", gops);
+
+        if (printResults) {
+            print_results_int(distanceMatrix, "DistanceMatrix");
+        }
+        if (validate) {
+            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
+            valid = validateResult(distanceMatrix, numNodes) ? 1 : 0;
+            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
+        }
+    }
+
+    checkMpi(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
+             "validation-status MPI_Bcast", rank);
+
+    checkCuda(cudaStreamDestroy(stream), "cudaStreamDestroy", rank);
+    checkCuda(cudaFree(devicePivotRow), "cudaFree(pivot row)", rank);
+    checkCuda(cudaFree(devicePath), "cudaFree(path)", rank);
+    checkCuda(cudaFree(deviceDistance), "cudaFree(distance)", rank);
+    checkCuda(cudaFreeHost(pivotHost), "cudaFreeHost(pivot row)", rank);
+    checkCuda(cudaFreeHost(localHostDistance), "cudaFreeHost(local matrix)", rank);
+    checkMpi(MPI_Comm_free(&nodeCommunicator), "MPI_Comm_free", rank);
+    MPI_Finalize();
+    return valid ? 0 : 1;
 }

+// Update all remaining local tiles. The pivot row is replicated, while each rank keeps
+// its pivot-column tiles local, so this phase requires no communication.
+__global__ void phase3Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,

+                            const size_t localRows,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnTile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowTile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const size_t tileColumn = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * TILE_SIZE;
+    const size_t localTileRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * TILE_SIZE;
+    const size_t globalTileRow = localRowBegin + localTileRow;
+    if (tileColumn == pivotGlobalRow || globalTileRow == pivotGlobalRow) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t pivotX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+
+            columnTile[y][x] = (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && pivotX < numNodes)
+                ? dist[localY * numNodes + pivotX]
+                : INF;
+            rowTile[y][x] = (pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y) < numNodes && globalX < numNodes)
+                ? pivotRow[static_cast<size_t>(y) * numNodes + globalX]
+                : INF;
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = columnTile[y][k] + rowTile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
             }
         }
     }
 }

+void checkMpi(const int result, const char* operation, const int rank) {
+    if (result != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(result, error, &length);

+// Close the diagonal tile. Each CUDA thread owns four cells; the padded shared-memory
+// stride avoids bank conflicts when a Floyd-Warshall step reads a column.
+__global__ void phase1Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = tile[y][k] + tile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+                tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);

+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }

+// its pivot-column tiles local, so this phase requires no communication.
+__global__ void phase3Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ pivotRow,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t localRowBegin,
+                            const size_t localRows,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnTile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowTile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const size_t tileColumn = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * TILE_SIZE;
+    const size_t localTileRow = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * TILE_SIZE;
+    const size_t globalTileRow = localRowBegin + localTileRow;
+    if (tileColumn == pivotGlobalRow || globalTileRow == pivotGlobalRow) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t pivotX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+
+            columnTile[y][x] = (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && pivotX < numNodes)
+                ? dist[localY * numNodes + pivotX]
+                : INF;
+            rowTile[y][x] = (pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y) < numNodes && globalX < numNodes)
+                ? pivotRow[static_cast<size_t>(y) * numNodes + globalX]
+                : INF;
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = columnTile[y][k] + rowTile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
                 }
             }
         }
     }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
 }

+// Close the diagonal tile. Each CUDA thread owns four cells; the padded shared-memory
+// stride avoids bank conflicts when a Floyd-Warshall step reads a column.
+__global__ void phase1Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = tile[y][k] + tile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+                tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);

+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }

+        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(pair / sample);
+        std::printf("Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\n", i, j, k);
+        return false;
+    }
     return true;
 }

+// Close the diagonal tile. Each CUDA thread owns four cells; the padded shared-memory
+// stride avoids bank conflicts when a Floyd-Warshall step reads a column.
+__global__ void phase1Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll

+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
                 }
             }
         }
     }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
 }

+// Close the diagonal tile. Each CUDA thread owns four cells; the padded shared-memory
+// stride avoids bank conflicts when a Floyd-Warshall step reads a column.
+__global__ void phase1Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = tile[y][k] + tile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+                // Row/column k cannot improve when the diagonal is zero. Leaving
+                // those shared cells untouched also removes read/write hazards.
+                if (y != k && x != k) {
+                    tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+                                     const size_t numNodes,

+// Close the diagonal tile. Each CUDA thread owns four cells; the padded shared-memory
+// stride avoids bank conflicts when a Floyd-Warshall step reads a column.
+__global__ void phase1Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = tile[y][k] + tile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+                // Row/column k cannot improve when the diagonal is zero. Leaving
+                // those shared cells untouched also removes read/write hazards.
+                if (y != k && x != k) {
+                    tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Close the diagonal tile. Each CUDA thread owns four cells; the padded shared-memory
+// stride avoids bank conflicts when a Floyd-Warshall step reads a column.
+__global__ void phase1Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = tile[y][k] + tile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+                // Row/column k cannot improve when the diagonal is zero. Leaving
+                // those shared cells untouched also removes read/write hazards.
+                if (y != k && x != k) {
+                    tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;

+        }

+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t pivotX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+
+            columnTile[y][x] = (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && pivotX < numNodes)
+                ? dist[localY * numNodes + pivotX]
+                : INF;
+            rowTile[y][x] = (pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y) < numNodes && globalX < numNodes)
+                ? pivotRow[static_cast<size_t>(y) * numNodes + globalX]
+                : INF;
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = columnTile[y][k] + rowTile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
                 }
             }
         }
     }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
 }

+// Close the diagonal tile. Each CUDA thread owns four cells; the padded shared-memory
+// stride avoids bank conflicts when a Floyd-Warshall step reads a column.
+__global__ void phase1Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = tile[y][k] + tile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+                // Row/column k cannot improve when the diagonal is zero. Leaving
+                // those shared cells untouched also removes read/write hazards.
+                if (y != k && x != k) {
+                    tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }

+#pragma unroll

+#pragma unroll

+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;

+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = columnTile[y][k] + rowTile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
                 }
             }
         }
     }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
 }

    58	    // Keep the original deterministic rand_r stream so external hashes remain identical.
    59	    unsigned int seed = 42;
    60	    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;
    61	
    62	    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {
    63	        dist[i] = rangeMin + static_cast<unsigned int>(
    64	            range * rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX));
    65	    }
    66	
    67	    // Host setup and validation use OpenMP; MPI calls remain on the main thread.
    68	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    69	    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(numNodes); ++i) {
    70	        dist[idx2(static_cast<size_t>(i), static_cast<size_t>(i), numNodes)] = 0;
    71	    }
    72	}

    74	__global__ void initializePathKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
    75	                                     const size_t elements,
    76	                                     const size_t numNodes,
    77	                                     const size_t globalRowBegin) {
    78	    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    79	    if (index < elements) {
    80	        path[index] = static_cast<unsigned int>(globalRowBegin + index / numNodes);

    91	    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
    92	
    93	    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
    94	    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
    95	    unsigned int values[2][2];
    96	    unsigned int paths[2][2];
    97	
    98	#pragma unroll
    99	    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
   100	#pragma unroll
   101	        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
   102	            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
   103	            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
   104	            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
   105	            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
   106	            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
   107	                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
   108	                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
   109	                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
   110	            } else {
   111	                values[ry][cx] = INF;
   112	                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
   113	            }
   114	            tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
   115	        }
   116	    }
   117	    __syncthreads();
   118	
   119	#pragma unroll
   120	    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
   121	#pragma unroll
   122	        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
   123	#pragma unroll
   124	            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
   125	                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
   126	                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
   127	                const unsigned int candidate = tile[y][k] + tile[k][x];
   128	                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
   129	                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
   130	                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
   131	                }
   132	                // Row/column k cannot improve when the diagonal is zero. Leaving
   133	                // those shared cells untouched also removes read/write hazards.
   134	                if (y != k && x != k) {
   135	                    tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
   136	                }
   137	            }
   138	        }
   139	        __syncthreads();
   140	    }
   141	
   142	#pragma unroll
   143	    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
   144	#pragma unroll
   145	        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
   146	            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
   147	            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
   148	            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
   149	            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
   150	            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
   210	            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
   211	                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
   212	                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
   213	                const unsigned int candidate = diagonal[y][k] + target[k][x];
   214	                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
   215	                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
   216	                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
   217	                }
   218	                if (y != k) {
   219	                    target[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
   220	                }
   221	            }
   222	        }
   223	        __syncthreads();
   224	    }
   225	
   226	#pragma unroll
   227	    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
   228	#pragma unroll
   229	        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
   230	            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
   231	            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
   232	            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
   233	            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
   234	            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
   235	                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
   236	                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
   237	                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
   238	            }
   239	        }
   240	    }
   241	}

   243	// Close the local tiles in the pivot tile column using the broadcast diagonal tile.
   244	__global__ void phase2ColumnKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
   245	                                  unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
   246	                                  const unsigned int* __restrict__ pivotRow,
   247	                                  const size_t numNodes,
   248	                                  const size_t localRowBegin,
   249	                                  const size_t localRows,
   250	                                  const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
   251	    __shared__ unsigned int diagonal[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
   252	    __shared__ unsigned int target[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
   253	
   254	    size_t localTileIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x);
   255	    if (pivotGlobalRow >= localRowBegin && pivotGlobalRow < localRowBegin + localRows) {
   256	        const size_t pivotLocalTile = (pivotGlobalRow - localRowBegin) / TILE_SIZE;
   257	        if (localTileIndex >= pivotLocalTile) {
   258	            ++localTileIndex;
   259	        }
   260	    }
   261	    const size_t localTileRow = localTileIndex * TILE_SIZE;
   262	    const size_t globalTileRow = localRowBegin + localTileRow;
   263	
   264	    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
   265	    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
   266	    unsigned int values[2][2];
   267	    unsigned int paths[2][2];
   268	
   269	#pragma unroll
   270	    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
   271	#pragma unroll
   272	        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
   273	            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
   274	            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
   275	            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
   276	            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
   277	            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
   278	
   279	            diagonal[y][x] = (pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y) < numNodes && globalX < numNodes)
   280	                ? pivotRow[static_cast<size_t>(y) * numNodes + globalX]

   326	                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
   327	                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
   328	                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
   329	            }
   330	        }
   331	    }
   332	}

   334	// Update all remaining local tiles. The pivot row is replicated, while each rank keeps
   335	// its pivot-column tiles local, so this phase requires no communication.
   336	__global__ void phase3Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
   337	                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
   338	                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ pivotRow,
   339	                            const size_t numNodes,
   340	                            const size_t localRowBegin,
   341	                            const size_t localRows,
   342	                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
   343	    __shared__ unsigned int columnTile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
   344	    __shared__ unsigned int rowTile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
   345	
   346	    size_t tileColumnIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x);
   347	    if (tileColumnIndex >= pivotGlobalRow / TILE_SIZE) {
   348	        ++tileColumnIndex;
   349	    }
   350	    const size_t tileColumn = tileColumnIndex * TILE_SIZE;
   351	
   352	    size_t localTileIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y);
   353	    if (pivotGlobalRow >= localRowBegin && pivotGlobalRow < localRowBegin + localRows) {
   354	        const size_t pivotLocalTile = (pivotGlobalRow - localRowBegin) / TILE_SIZE;
   355	        if (localTileIndex >= pivotLocalTile) {
   356	            ++localTileIndex;
   357	        }
   358	    }
   359	    const size_t localTileRow = localTileIndex * TILE_SIZE;
   360	    const size_t globalTileRow = localRowBegin + localTileRow;
   361	
   362	    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
   363	    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
   364	    unsigned int values[2][2];
   365	    unsigned int paths[2][2];
   366	
   367	#pragma unroll
   368	    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
   369	#pragma unroll
   370	        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
   371	            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
   372	            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
   373	            const size_t localY = localTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
   374	            const size_t globalY = globalTileRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
   375	            const size_t pivotX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
   376	            const size_t globalX = tileColumn + static_cast<size_t>(x);
   377	
   378	            columnTile[y][x] = (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && pivotX < numNodes)
   379	                ? dist[localY * numNodes + pivotX]
   380	                : INF;
   381	            rowTile[y][x] = (pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y) < numNodes && globalX < numNodes)
   382	                ? pivotRow[static_cast<size_t>(y) * numNodes + globalX]
   383	                : INF;
   384	            if (localY < localRows && globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
   385	                const size_t position = localY * numNodes + globalX;
   386	                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
   387	                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
   388	            } else {
   389	                values[ry][cx] = INF;
   390	                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
   475	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
   476	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   477	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\n");
   478	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   479	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   480	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   481	}

   483	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   484	    int provided = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   485	    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);
   486	
   487	    int rank = 0;
   488	    int worldSize = 1;
   489	    checkMpi(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank), "MPI_Comm_rank", rank);
   490	    checkMpi(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize), "MPI_Comm_size", rank);
   491	    if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   492	        abortMpi("MPI does not provide the required FUNNELED thread support", rank);
   493	    }
   494	
   495	    size_t numNodes = 512;
   496	    bool validate = false;
   497	    bool printResults = false;
   498	    bool showHelp = false;
   499	    bool argumentsValid = true;
   500	
   501	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   502	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   503	            char* end = nullptr;
   504	            const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(argv[++i], &end, 10);
   505	            if (end == argv[i] || *end != '\0' || parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
   506	                argumentsValid = false;
   507	            } else {
   508	                numNodes = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
   509	            }
   510	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   511	            validate = true;
   512	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   513	            printResults = true;
   514	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   515	            showHelp = true;
   516	        } else {
   517	            argumentsValid = false;
   518	            if (rank == 0) {
   519	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   520	            }
   521	        }
   522	    }
   523	
   524	    if (showHelp || !argumentsValid) {
   525	        if (rank == 0) {
   526	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   527	        }
   528	        MPI_Finalize();
   529	        return argumentsValid ? 0 : 1;
   530	    }
   531	
   532	    if (numNodes != 0 && numNodes > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / numNodes) {
   533	        abortMpi("matrix dimensions overflow size_t", rank);
   534	    }
   535	    if (numNodes > std::numeric_limits<unsigned int>::max()) {
   536	        abortMpi("path indices require at most UINT_MAX nodes", rank);
   537	    }
   538	
   539	    int localRank = 0;
   540	    int nodeSize = 1;
   541	    MPI_Comm nodeCommunicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   542	    checkMpi(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank,
   543	                                 MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeCommunicator),
   544	             "MPI_Comm_split_type", rank);
   545	    checkMpi(MPI_Comm_rank(nodeCommunicator, &localRank), "node-local MPI_Comm_rank", rank);
   546	    checkMpi(MPI_Comm_size(nodeCommunicator, &nodeSize), "node-local MPI_Comm_size", rank);
   547	
   548	    int deviceCount = 0;
   549	    checkCuda(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount), "cudaGetDeviceCount", rank);
   550	    if (deviceCount == 0) {
   551	        abortMpi("the hybrid benchmark requires at least one CUDA device per node", rank);
   552	    }
   553	    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;
   554	    checkCuda(cudaSetDevice(device), "cudaSetDevice", rank);
   555	    cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};
   556	    checkCuda(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, device), "cudaGetDeviceProperties", rank);
   557	
   558	    const size_t tileCount = (numNodes + TILE_SIZE - 1) / TILE_SIZE;
   559	    const size_t rankTileBegin = tileCount * static_cast<size_t>(rank) / worldSize;
   560	    const size_t rankTileEnd = tileCount * static_cast<size_t>(rank + 1) / worldSize;
   561	    const size_t localRowBegin = rankTileBegin * TILE_SIZE;
   562	    const size_t localRowEnd = std::min(numNodes, rankTileEnd * TILE_SIZE);
   563	    const size_t localRows = localRowEnd - localRowBegin;
   564	    const size_t localElements = localRows * numNodes;
   565	
   566	    std::vector<int> counts(static_cast<size_t>(worldSize));
   567	    std::vector<int> displacements(static_cast<size_t>(worldSize));
   568	    for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; ++r) {
   569	        const size_t tileBegin = tileCount * static_cast<size_t>(r) / worldSize;
   570	        const size_t tileEnd = tileCount * static_cast<size_t>(r + 1) / worldSize;
   571	        const size_t rowBegin = tileBegin * TILE_SIZE;
   572	        const size_t rowEnd = std::min(numNodes, tileEnd * TILE_SIZE);
   573	        const size_t count = (rowEnd - rowBegin) * numNodes;
   574	        const size_t displacement = rowBegin * numNodes;
   575	        if (count > INT_MAX || displacement > INT_MAX) {
   576	            abortMpi("matrix is too large for MPI_Scatterv/MPI_Gatherv integer counts", rank);
   577	        }
   578	        counts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
   579	        displacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(displacement);
   580	    }
   581	
   582	    if (rank == 0) {
   583	        std::printf("Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\n");
   584	        std::printf("Number of nodes: %zu\n", numNodes);
   585	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   586	        std::printf("Hybrid configuration: %d MPI rank(s), up to %d OpenMP thread(s) per rank\n",
   587	                    worldSize, omp_get_max_threads());
   588	        std::printf("CUDA device on rank 0: %s (tile size %d)\n",
   589	                    deviceProperties.name, TILE_SIZE);
   590	        if (nodeSize > deviceCount) {
   591	            std::printf("Warning: multiple MPI ranks share each CUDA device on this node\n");
   592	        }
   593	    }
   594	
   595	    std::vector<unsigned int> distanceMatrix;
   596	    if (rank == 0) {
   597	        distanceMatrix.resize(numNodes * numNodes);
   598	        std::printf("Initializing graph...\n");
   599	        initializeDistanceMatrix(distanceMatrix, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);
   600	    }
   601	
   602	    unsigned int* localHostDistance = nullptr;
   603	    unsigned int* pivotHost = nullptr;
   604	    unsigned int* deviceDistance = nullptr;
   605	    unsigned int* devicePath = nullptr;
   606	    unsigned int* devicePivotRow = nullptr;
   607	    const size_t allocatedLocalElements = std::max<size_t>(localElements, 1);
   608	    const size_t pivotCapacity = std::max<size_t>(TILE_SIZE * numNodes, 1);
   609	
   610	    checkCuda(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&localHostDistance),
   611	                             allocatedLocalElements * sizeof(unsigned int)),
   612	              "cudaMallocHost(local matrix)", rank);
   613	    checkCuda(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pivotHost),
   614	                             pivotCapacity * sizeof(unsigned int)),
   615	              "cudaMallocHost(pivot row)", rank);
   616	    checkCuda(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceDistance),
   617	                         allocatedLocalElements * sizeof(unsigned int)),
   618	              "cudaMalloc(distance)", rank);
   619	    checkCuda(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&devicePath),
   620	                         allocatedLocalElements * sizeof(unsigned int)),
   650	        std::printf("Computing shortest paths...\n");
   651	    }
   652	    checkMpi(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD), "pre-compute MPI_Barrier", rank);
   653	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   654	
   655	    const dim3 threads(THREAD_TILE, THREAD_TILE);
   656	    const unsigned int matrixTileCount = static_cast<unsigned int>(tileCount);
   657	    const unsigned int localTileCount = static_cast<unsigned int>(rankTileEnd - rankTileBegin);
   658	
   659	    for (size_t pivotTile = 0; pivotTile < tileCount; ++pivotTile) {
   660	        const size_t pivotGlobalRow = pivotTile * TILE_SIZE;
   661	        const size_t pivotRows = std::min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE_SIZE), numNodes - pivotGlobalRow);
   662	        const int pivotOwner = static_cast<int>(
   663	            ((pivotTile + 1) * static_cast<size_t>(worldSize) - 1) / tileCount);
   664	
   665	        if (rank == pivotOwner) {
   666	            const size_t pivotLocalRow = pivotGlobalRow - localRowBegin;
   667	            phase1Kernel<<<1, threads, 0, stream>>>(deviceDistance, devicePath, numNodes,
   668	                                                    pivotLocalRow, pivotGlobalRow);
   669	            checkCuda(cudaPeekAtLastError(), "phase1Kernel launch", rank);
   670	
   671	            if (matrixTileCount > 1) {
   672	                phase2RowKernel<<<matrixTileCount - 1, threads, 0, stream>>>(
   673	                    deviceDistance, devicePath, numNodes, pivotLocalRow, pivotGlobalRow);
   674	                checkCuda(cudaPeekAtLastError(), "phase2RowKernel launch", rank);
   675	            }
   676	
   677	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(pivotHost,
   678	                                      deviceDistance + pivotLocalRow * numNodes,
   679	                                      pivotRows * numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int),
   680	                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
   681	                      "pivot row device-to-host copy", rank);
   682	            checkCuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), "pivot row production", rank);
   683	        }
   684	
   685	        const size_t pivotElements = pivotRows * numNodes;
   686	        if (pivotElements > static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
   687	            abortMpi("pivot row is too large for MPI_Bcast", rank);
   688	        }
   689	        checkMpi(MPI_Bcast(pivotHost, static_cast<int>(pivotElements), MPI_UNSIGNED,
   690	                           pivotOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
   691	                 "pivot-row MPI_Bcast", rank);
   692	
   693	        checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(devicePivotRow, pivotHost,
   694	                                  pivotElements * sizeof(unsigned int),
   695	                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream),
   696	                  "pivot row host-to-device copy", rank);
   697	
   698	        const bool ownsPivotTile = pivotTile >= rankTileBegin && pivotTile < rankTileEnd;
   699	        const unsigned int nonPivotLocalTiles = localTileCount - (ownsPivotTile ? 1U : 0U);
   700	        if (nonPivotLocalTiles != 0) {
   701	            phase2ColumnKernel<<<nonPivotLocalTiles, threads, 0, stream>>>(
   702	                deviceDistance, devicePath, devicePivotRow, numNodes,
   703	                localRowBegin, localRows, pivotGlobalRow);
   704	            checkCuda(cudaPeekAtLastError(), "phase2ColumnKernel launch", rank);
   705	
   706	            if (matrixTileCount > 1) {
   707	                const dim3 phase3Grid(matrixTileCount - 1, nonPivotLocalTiles);
   708	                phase3Kernel<<<phase3Grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(
   709	                    deviceDistance, devicePath, devicePivotRow, numNodes,
   710	                    localRowBegin, localRows, pivotGlobalRow);
   711	                checkCuda(cudaPeekAtLastError(), "phase3Kernel launch", rank);
   712	            }
   713	        }
   714	    }
   715	
   716	    if (localElements != 0) {
   717	        checkCuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(localHostDistance, deviceDistance,
   718	                                  localElements * sizeof(unsigned int),
   719	                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream),
   720	                  "result device-to-host copy", rank);
   721	    }
   722	    checkCuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream), "final CUDA synchronization", rank);
   723	
   724	    checkMpi(MPI_Gatherv(localHostDistance, static_cast<int>(localElements), MPI_UNSIGNED,
   725	                         rank == 0 ? distanceMatrix.data() : nullptr,
   726	                         counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_UNSIGNED,
   727	                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
   728	             "MPI_Gatherv", rank);
   729	
   730	    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;

codex
Implemented the hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA Floyd–Warshall benchmark in-place.

- Added tiled CUDA kernels with shared-memory blocking and register tiling.
- Distributed tile rows across MPI ranks with pivot-row broadcasts and pinned staging buffers.
- Added OpenMP host initialization and validation.
- Assigned MPI ranks to node-local GPUs automatically.
- Updated [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/floydwarshall_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r2/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt:1) for required MPI, OpenMP, and native CUDA compilation.
- Kept the executable name `floydwarshall` and created no project files.

Validation passed for matrices through 2048 nodes. Exact original result hashes matched for single-rank and 2–5-rank executions, including partial tiles and GPU oversubscription.

Typical launch:

```bash
OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 mpirun -np 4 ./floydwarshall -n 2048 -v
```

+// Close the diagonal tile. Each CUDA thread owns four cells; the padded shared-memory
+// stride avoids bank conflicts when a Floyd-Warshall step reads a column.
+__global__ void phase1Kernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                            unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                            const size_t numNodes,
+                            const size_t pivotLocalRow,
+                            const size_t pivotGlobalRow) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
+    unsigned int values[2][2];
+    unsigned int paths[2][2];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                values[ry][cx] = dist[position];
+                paths[ry][cx] = path[position];
+            } else {
+                values[ry][cx] = INF;
+                paths[ry][cx] = 0;
+            }
+            tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+                const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+                const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+                const unsigned int candidate = tile[y][k] + tile[k][x];
+                if (candidate < values[ry][cx]) {
+                    values[ry][cx] = candidate;
+                    paths[ry][cx] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotGlobalRow + k);
+                }
+                // Row/column k cannot improve when the diagonal is zero. Leaving
+                // those shared cells untouched also removes read/write hazards.
+                if (y != k && x != k) {
+                    tile[y][x] = values[ry][cx];
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ry = 0; ry < 2; ++ry) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int cx = 0; cx < 2; ++cx) {
+            const int y = ty + ry * THREAD_TILE;
+            const int x = tx + cx * THREAD_TILE;
+            const size_t globalY = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y);
+            const size_t globalX = pivotGlobalRow + static_cast<size_t>(x);
+            if (globalY < numNodes && globalX < numNodes) {
+                const size_t position = (pivotLocalRow + static_cast<size_t>(y)) * numNodes + globalX;
+                dist[position] = values[ry][cx];
+                path[position] = paths[ry][cx];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
